results.bound: O((|T||P|)^{1-\epsilon}) \text{ for any } \epsilon>0 \text{ (conditional lower bound under SETH)}
results.quote: Neither SegE nor MinSegE over an alphabet of size three can be solved in O((|T||P|)^{1-\epsilon}) time for any \epsilon>0, unless SETH fails.
The problem MinSegE can be solved in O(|T||P|) time.
The problem SegE with input f=2 can be decided in O(|T|+|P|) time with O(|P|) space.
The problem SegE with input f=2 can be decided in O(|T|+|P|) time with O(|P|) space.

Given strings T_1 and T_2 with |T_1|\le|T_2| over a linearly sortable alphabet, and integer f, the problem SegLCS can be solved in O(f|T_2|(|T_1|-\ell+1)) time using O(\ell(|T_1|-\ell/f+1)) space, where \ell=\mathsf{slcs}(T_1,T_2,f).

Given strings T_1 and T_2 with |T_1|\le|T_2| over a linearly sortable alphabet, and integer f, the problem SegLCS can be solved in O(f|T_2|(|T_1|-\ell+1)) time using O(\ell(|T_1|-\ell/f+1)) space, where \ell=\mathsf{slcs}(T_1,T_2,f).

The problem IndSegLCS can be solved in O(g_1 g_2 n_1 n_2) time for input T_1,T_2,f_1,f_2, where n_1=|T_1|, n_2=|T_2|, g_1=\min\{f_1,\max\{\lceil|T_1|/2\rceil-f_1,1\}\}, and g_2=\min\{f_2,\max\{\lceil|T_2|/2\rceil-f_2,1\}\}.
